## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm run test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check` pass
- [ ] `npm run type-check` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] No unintended regressions to the wishlist, persistence, or existing features
- [ ] Changes are accessible and responsive where relevant
